name: Answer Engine Optimization for ChatGPT, Gemini, AEO, AIO, SEO
author: SuperSharpAI

sections.description:
AI Content Optimizer helps your site speak the language of modern AI engines.

Today, people rely on ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google Search AI Preview and other AI systems to find direct answers to their questions. Traditional SEO is no longer enough — your content needs to be structured and formatted for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) also called Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) / Artificial Intelligence Optimization (AIO) also called Artificial Intelligence Optimisation (AIO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Search Engine Optimization (SEO) also called Search Engine Optimisation (SEO). Let AI Know Your Business.

This plugin helps you:

🧠 Automatically generate FAQ questions and answers using AI
💡 Add Quick Answer (summary) blocks to your content
✅ Check if your post or page is AI-optimized
🧾 Insert structured FAQ schema (JSON-LD) into your content
⚙️ Show AEO/AIO / SEO/GEO status in a side meta box
🔧 Set up AI API key, endpoint, and model easily

Whether you’re a blogger, marketer, or business owner — this plugin helps ensure your content is visible and valuable to AI systems. You can make your website ChatGPT, Google Gemini (AEO / AIO SEO), Microsoft Copilot ready with in 5 minutes. If you do not want to display FAQs / Quick Answer, you can set FAQs and Quick answer in any pages you want. It help you to list your any page / post in Answer Engines.

Features

  • AI-powered FAQ generator
  • Quick Answer block editor
  • FAQ JSON-LD schema support
  • AI optimization checklist:
    • H1 tag presence
    • FAQ block count
    • Quick Answer availability
    • JSON-LD schema detection
  • Easy-to-use settings page for API configuration
  • Works with both Classic and Block Editor
  • Display FAQs and Quick Answer in desired post / page

Easy to Use:
– Setup Plugin and Activate
– Go to Add / Edit Page, You can see Metabox
– You can Add FAQs / Quick Answer Manually (without any configuration)
– If you want to make it automatic, you can setup AI keys (optional)
– You can find more info about plugin and user guide at Click Here

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/make-website-aeo-ai-ready directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to **Settings > Answer Engine Optimization – Settings ** and enter your AI API key, model (e.g. gpt-3.5-turbo), and endpoint.
  4. Edit any page to see optimization status and generate AI-ready content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Gutenberg and Classic Editor?

Yes, it works with both.

Is AI required to use this plugin?

No, for general setup. but, you’ll need an AI API key to generate FAQs and Quick Answers. If you do not want to use OpenAI, you can add content manually.

What is AEO / GEO?

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) / GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the process of optimizing content so that AI systems can understand, extract, and deliver your content as answers. More information

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes. After generation, you can review and edit the questions, answers, and summaries.
